scope: Only the 28 split/multi pair-network main B<C loops. Excludes GPT family scans, null-model best_x scans, matrix construction, graph/reduce, reading/parsing and output packaging.
proof_of_exact_pair_count: finalize_total writes finite count, including zero, iff the stock mask is true. Thus finite positions of each *_x0topk5_count recover the exact mask.

For a chain with m active stocks, the main nested loop can visit at most C(m,2) distinct B<C pairs. Each TopK band increments at most K stock counters for each such pair; skipped or invalid candidates only lower that sum.
Every stored count is an integer <= C(m,2) < 2^24, so the f32 output conversion is exact. Summing those values as f64 is exact at these totals.
For all 28 chains and every available h/g TopK band, the observed sum equals K*C(m,2). This saturates the upper bound and proves all possible active pairs reached TopK and supplied K finite winners.

Having K finite winners also rules out the later invalid-winner continue, so each such pair reached the original mass-call point. Therefore h/g calls, accepted pairs, and mass calls each equal C(m,2).
The producer loops over n=5107, not m-2; masked and B/C positions are still represented in the full vector. Workload per chain is n*C(m,2).

formulas.topk_subblocks: [floor(k*n/512), floor((k+1)*n/512)), k=0..511; each is within one mass block
formulas.pairs_per_block: sum_{b in block and mask[b]} sum_{c>b} mask[c]

per_element_cost_model.units: Logical data payload transferred between scalar/vector registers and cache; not DRAM bytes, no cache-line, write-allocate, retry, spills or prefetch accounting. Bulk SIMD operations only; tails and B/C scalar handling excluded from arithmetic counts.

h_g_production_plus_stats.breakdown: Read p,q,addm (3*f32); write h,g (2*f32). h=2 mul+2 add; g=1 sub; retained statistics=3 add+1 mul. Max/compare, masks, popcount, scalar horizontal sums and setup are extra. B/C-special blocks and scalar tail differ.

mass_pair1_both_flags_true.breakdown: h,g:8B; six accumulators read/write:24+24B. Per enabled flag:3 mul+3 add.

mass_flag_general.caveat: Source loads both h/g before flag branches; compiled code may avoid unused score loads. g-only needs only g. Both-true56B is unambiguous. Actual28-chain flags are now recorded under mass_flags_diagnostic for both modes.

mass_batch4_all_both_true.formula: (4*8 + 48)/4 = 20B, versus 56B pair1; six accumulators loaded/stored once per 4 pairs
mass_batch4_all_both_true.caveat: A batch always loads/stores six vector accumulators in the current candidate; mixed flags may make batching wasteful. Original helper handles the 3-element tail pair by pair.

topk_selection_first_pass.breakdown: Both score arrays need >=1 complete scan. Comparison/mask/integer-key work dominates; every finite packed key uses 2 multiplies and rounding, but only sampled/accepted candidates are packed on the threshold path. Retry/full-key pass and candidate counts are data-dependent and not logged for the real day.

topk_absorb_excluded_from_per_n_element_.minimum_arithmetic_per_valid_cell_update: 2 f64 adds plus integer count increment; positive score also does division and mass add
topk_absorb_excluded_from_per_n_element_.note: Count read/write=8B and two f64 sum read/write=32B; optional mass sum adds16B. Index/h/g/prefix reads and sorting are extra.

conditional_logical_traffic_decimal_TB.exclusions: No sampled key work, retries, TopK accumulations, output matrices, score/block setup or cache traffic overhead. These are NOT physical DRAM transfer totals.

bulk_arithmetic_scenarios.unknowns: Actual flags, scalar tail positive branches, TopK candidate/round/division counts, instructions and dependency stalls.

hardware_evidence.architecture_source_details: AMD publication 57647 rev1.01 (April2023), section2.12/page39: at most two 256-bit loads and one 256-bit store/cycle; section2.6.2.2/page18: 512-bit accesses use 256-bit pipelines over two cycles. Primary AMD-authored document, externally hosted copy.
hardware_evidence.actual_memory_population_bandwidth_frequ: unknown; not measured by this audit

conditional_hardware_bounds_for_current_.classification: Optimistic resource ceilings applied to the CURRENT vector materialization. Not a universal lower bound over all equivalent algorithms, not a runtime forecast, not a proof of being within 2x the optimum.
assumptions: 50 workers each have a distinct physical core; using 50 cores is an optimistic resource ceiling even if scheduling uses fewer.
All operate at vendor maximum3.10GHz; all data are perfectly aligned and hit L1, no stalls or overhead.
Retain current vector output stores and stated source traffic. No compiler elimination, fusion or redesign removing these transfers.
Arithmetic and memory overlap, so take max of resource demands, not their sum; operations outside the counted bulk only raise current-code time.
conditional_hardware_bounds_for_current_.producer_store_formula: 8*Nv/(50*3.10e9*32); ignores all other work and the scalar tail
conditional_hardware_bounds_for_current_.pair1_formula: max(52*Nv/load_roof,32*Nv/store_roof); h/g + mass + one TopK scan, ignoring extra work
conditional_hardware_bounds_for_current_.batch4_formula: max(34*Nv/load_roof,14*Nv/store_roof); ideal full batches, ignoring partials and tails
conditional_hardware_bounds_for_current_.reason_no_problem_wide_numeric_bound: No proof that every equivalent algorithm must materialize these intermediates or perform these instructions; total mandatory DRAM/I/O traffic and sustained bandwidth have not been measured. Dividing156TB logical traffic by921.6GB/s would incorrectly charge cache hits to DRAM.

existing_microbench_local_extrapolations.classification: Measured single-core synthetic kernels scaled by exact call counts and ideal50-way parallelism. Estimates only; neither whole-market measurements nor hard lower bounds.
limitations: Real score distributions, positive flags, NUMA/caches, vector alignment, concurrent chains and TopK retry counts can differ.
Top100 benchmark does not cover the13 Top20 multi nets.
Do not sum staged-copy mass micro with h/g micro: actual production writes directly into buffers, while staged micro adds a copying producer.
Micro data sets fit a small hot working set; full production matrix/cache pressure differs.

conclusion: Main pair work is exactly1.861825753644e12 pair-stock elements on20241231. The available conditional ceilings are far too loose to claim a hardware limit; the whole-function theoretical minimum remains unknown. Existing micro estimates identify optimization scope but cannot justify stopping at2x optimum.

observed_flag_weighted_cost_model.formula: Enabled flag count I=h_only+g_only+2*both. Here none=g_only=0, so mass read=nv*(8*P+12*I); write=nv*12*I; arithmetic=6*nv*I.
observed_flag_weighted_cost_model.scope_warning: Logical source payload / conditional current-code resource model, NOT DRAM bytes, full-run benchmark, or universal algorithm lower bound. Full-n traffic approximates3 scalar tail positions; bulk formulas exclude them exactly.
